title: HNK education workers’ general strike continuing from November
summary: RFE/RL reports a general strike starting 26 November and continuing in December over a 15% wage demand; a 23 December court order again ruled the strike unlawful. This strike/campaign is continuity context only; December public marches on 10 and 23 December are separate event candidates with their own reported turnout. Workforce and strike size do not substitute for march attendance.
open_questions: Does the original episode manual treat these discrete marches as separate actions within a continuing strike campaign? Do not merge without the onset/lull rule.
